title: IELTS API: a free, no-authentication REST API and open dataset for IELTS preparation research
description: Archived release (v1.1.0) of the IELTS API source code and datasets: Cambridge IELTS 1-22 vocabulary, band descriptors and score concordances, exam formats for the four skills, a machine-readable question-type taxonomy with strategy playbooks, raw-mark to band conversion tables, a 50-topic bank with collocation inventories, and a verified structural catalog of an open community practice estate. Cite this record, or the version-specific DOI, when you use the API or the datasets in research.
